text: {"assertions":["A missed run bug in worker/scheduler/cron.py background jobs was discovered and fixed on 2026-02-21.","The bug only manifested with deeply nested inputs beyond six levels in depth.","The root cause was the config loader reading the wrong environment file.","The bug could be reproduced by advancing a fake clock across the schedule.","A symptom of the bug was a scheduler slot with no execution record.","The fix made environment selection explicit and implemented fail-closed behavior on ambiguity.","The fix was implemented in PR #1459 on the fix/missed-run-1 branch.","Fixing the bug reclaimed 6 GB of blob storage."]}
